_comment: Sidebar categories (Category > Group > Script). A runner picks one with "category": "<name>" (matched case-insensitively). Order here = order in the sidebar rail. 'icon' is a Material Icons name from the bundled material-design-icons@3.0.1 font (lowercase_with_underscores - check web-src/node_modules/material-design-icons/iconfont/codepoints) or any other short text/emoji, rendered as-is (e.g. the £ below). A category a runner uses that isn't listed is appended automatically with default_icon - edit its icon afterwards. Runners with no category go under 'uncategorised', always shown last.
